findings.title: Keep consolidation configuration paired with its provider helper
findings.body: If the owner switches providers before stage one starts or between stage-one completion and this check, this shadows `config` with the new provider configuration. However, `MemoryStartupContext.provider` still holds the startup provider, and `phase2::agent::get_config` uses that old provider to choose the consolidation model. For example, an OpenAI-to-Z.ai switch can send `gpt-5.6-terra` to the Z.ai endpoint, causing consolidation to fail. The smallest scoped fix is to use this refresh as a policy gate without replacing phase two's original, internally consistent configuration/provider pair.

overall_explanation: The dispatch guards and completion checks address the scoped denial boundary, but passing refreshed configuration into consolidation introduces a concrete provider/model mismatch. Review used read-only source inspection and recorded qualification evidence; no tests were run.
